entries.champion.9001.title: Protector of Helios
entries.champion.9001.ability.name: AESA
entries.champion.9001.ability.desc: Gains a shield worth 12/22/40% of max HP for 1.75/2/2.25 s. While it holds, takes 5/12/25% less damage.
entries.champion.9001.passive.name: Helios Plating
entries.champion.9001.passive.desc: Gains 5/10/20% bonus max HP, Armor and Magic Resist.
entries.champion.9002.name: Baira
entries.champion.9002.title: Purple Sniper
entries.champion.9002.ability.name: Ardeat's Destiny
entries.champion.9002.ability.desc: Every 5th attack burns everything within 3 hexes of the target for magic damage (100/100/90% of Ability Power) over 2.5/2/1.75 s, and grants 20/25/35% Attack Speed for 5 s. Repeated burns stack.
entries.champion.9002.passive.name: Wound
entries.champion.9002.passive.desc: Her attacks apply Wound: the target's healing is reduced by 30%.
entries.champion.9003.name: Cyla
entries.champion.9003.title: Eye of Hexa
entries.champion.9003.ability.name: Rocket Strike
entries.champion.9003.ability.desc: Can attack while casting. Fires a rocket dealing physical damage equal to 100% of the damage she dealt in the last 2 s. Adjacent hexes take 25%.
entries.champion.9005.name: Faire
entries.champion.9005.title: Arm of the Future
entries.champion.9005.ability.name: Temporal Stun
entries.champion.9005.ability.desc: Deals magic damage (100% Ability Power + 10/15/20% Attack Damage) and stuns the target for longer the more damage she recently dealt to it. Adjacent enemies are stunned for 60% as long. Also casts when she dies.
entries.champion.9006.name: Les
entries.champion.9006.title: Wall of Omnilium
entries.champion.9006.ability.name: Wall of Omnilium
entries.champion.9006.ability.desc: Roots the 3 closest enemies for 1/1.5/3 s, then enters Wall Mode for 3/5/15 s: roots himself, gains +30/50/100% max HP, Armor and Magic Resist, heals for 10/10/20% of the damage he takes, and makes allies in his row immune to crowd control.
entries.champion.9007.name: Lum
entries.champion.9007.title: Guardian of Omnilium
entries.champion.9007.ability.name: Guardian's Punch
entries.champion.9007.ability.desc: Punches the target for 15/30/100% of his Attack Damage. The 2 hexes behind the target take 7/15/50% of his Attack Damage and are knocked up for 1/1.5/5 s.
entries.champion.9007.passive.name: Omnilium Might
entries.champion.9007.passive.desc: Starts combat with 15/30/100% bonus Armor, Magic Resist and Attack Damage.
entries.champion.9008.name: Astra
entries.champion.9008.ability.name: Starbound Tether
entries.champion.9008.ability.desc: Tethers to the ally that dealt the most damage in the last 5 s, for 5 s: 30% of the damage that ally takes is redirected to Astra, and the ally gains 20/30/50% Attack Speed.
entries.champion.9009.name: Lunis
entries.champion.9009.title: The Crescent Shadow
entries.champion.9009.ability.name: Crescent Slash
entries.champion.9009.ability.desc: Slashes in a cone 2 hexes long for 150/225/350 physical damage. On a kill, drops aggro for 1.5 s.
entries.champion.9009.passive.name: Shadow Dive
entries.champion.9009.passive.desc: At the start of combat, jumps behind the farthest enemy and is untargetable for 2 s.
entries.champion.9010.name: Soul
entries.champion.9010.title: The Lost Vessel
entries.champion.9010.ability.name: Soul Rend
entries.champion.9010.ability.desc: Deals 120/180/280 physical damage and permanently steals 15/20/30% of the target's Attack Damage and Armor for the rest of the fight.
entries.champion.9010.passive.name: Undying Shell
entries.champion.9010.passive.desc: Starts combat with a 560/840/1300 shield that never expires, and cannot be healed. Each attack restores 20/30/50 shield (up to 800/1200/1800).
entries.champion.9011.name: Myna
entries.champion.9011.title: The Tidecaller
entries.champion.9011.ability.name: Lunar Blessing
entries.champion.9011.ability.desc: Heals the lowest-HP ally for 200/300/500 and deals 200/300/500 magic damage to the highest-HP enemy within 2 hexes of her target.
entries.champion.9012.name: Vega
entries.champion.9012.title: The Supernova
entries.champion.9012.ability.name: Starfall Channel
entries.champion.9012.ability.desc: Channels for 4 s: every 0.5 s strikes a random enemy for 75/115/300 magic damage (8 strikes). If the channel completes, deals 375/600/1500 magic damage to every enemy on the board.
entries.champion.9013.name: Ignis
entries.champion.9013.ability.name: Ember Ward
entries.champion.9014.name: Pyra
entries.champion.9014.ability.name: Piercing Arrow
entries.champion.9014.ability.desc: Fires a piercing arrow dealing 120/180/270 physical damage to the target and to the enemy 1 hex behind it.
entries.champion.9015.name: Vex
entries.champion.9015.ability.name: Cull
entries.champion.9015.ability.desc: Blinks next to the lowest-HP enemy and deals 150/225/350 physical damage.
entries.champion.9016.name: Null
entries.champion.9016.ability.name: Gravity Well
entries.champion.9016.ability.desc: Deals 80/120/200 magic damage and pulls the target 1 hex closer.
entries.champion.9017.name: Bone
entries.champion.9017.ability.name: Skull Bash
entries.champion.9017.ability.desc: Bashes the target for 100/150/225 physical damage and stuns it for 1.5 s.
entries.champion.9018.name: Rot
entries.champion.9018.ability.name: Blight
entries.champion.9018.ability.desc: Poisons the target for 120/180/280 magic damage over 3 s.
entries.champion.9019.name: Bit
entries.champion.9019.ability.name: Breakthrough
entries.champion.9019.ability.desc: Dashes through the target to the hex behind it, dealing 120/180/270 physical damage.
entries.champion.9020.name: Solis
entries.champion.9020.ability.name: Solar Strike
entries.champion.9020.ability.desc: Empowers his next attack (within 8 s): it deals 150/225/350 physical damage and shreds 20% of the target's Armor for 3 s.
entries.champion.9021.name: Xul
entries.champion.9021.ability.name: Void Bolt
entries.champion.9021.ability.desc: Fires a void bolt for 150/225/350 magic damage that bounces to 1 adjacent enemy for the same damage.
entries.champion.9022.name: Grave
entries.champion.9022.ability.name: Raise Skeleton
entries.champion.9022.ability.desc: Spawns a Skeleton with 300/500/800 HP and 30 Attack Damage on the nearest empty hex.
entries.champion.9023.name: Byte
entries.champion.9023.ability.name: Firewall
entries.champion.9023.ability.desc: Grants the lowest-HP ally a 150/225/375 shield for 3 s.
entries.champion.9024.name: Orion
entries.champion.9024.ability.name: Concussive Shot
entries.champion.9024.ability.desc: Deals 180/270/400 physical damage and knocks the target back 1 hex.
entries.champion.9025.name: Nyx
entries.champion.9025.ability.name: Cleave
entries.champion.9025.ability.desc: Cleaves all adjacent enemies for 150/225/350 physical damage.
entries.champion.9026.name: Flare
entries.champion.9026.ability.name: Sunbeam
entries.champion.9026.ability.desc: Calls a sunbeam dealing 200/300/500 magic damage in a 1-hex radius.
entries.champion.9027.name: Lich
entries.champion.9027.ability.name: Soul Drain
entries.champion.9027.ability.desc: Drains the target for 250/375/600 magic damage over 2 s, healing himself for 100% of the damage.
entries.champion.9028.name: Raa
entries.champion.9028.ability.name: Solar Leap
entries.champion.9028.ability.desc: Leaps next to the highest-HP enemy and deals 350/525/1000 physical damage.
entries.champion.9029.name: Kryx
entries.champion.9029.ability.name: Frenzy
entries.champion.9029.ability.desc: Enters a frenzy for 5 s: gains 50/75/150% Attack Speed but takes 10% more damage.
entries.champion.9030.name: Mortis
entries.champion.9030.ability.name: Death's Volley
entries.champion.9030.ability.desc: His next 3 basic attacks (within 10 s) deal 115/175/300 bonus physical damage and ignore 50% of the target's Armor.
entries.champion.9031.name: Umbra
entries.champion.9031.ability.name: Eclipse
entries.champion.9031.ability.desc: Deals 300/450/1000 magic damage to all enemies within 2 hexes and blinds them for 3 s (they cannot basic attack).
entries.champion.9101.name: Skeleton
entries.champion.9101.desc: Summoned by Grave's Raise Skeleton. Exists only for the fight.
entries.champion.9102.name: Lost Soul

entries.champion.9102.desc: Summoned by the Coregons synergy. Untargetable; exists only for the fight.

entries.trait.1.name: Helios
entries.trait.1.bp3: Helios units' basic attacks burn their target for 2% of its max HP as true damage over 3 s.
entries.trait.1.bp6: Helios units' basic attacks burn their target for 5% of its max HP as true damage over 3 s.
entries.trait.2.name: Phaisa
entries.trait.2.bp3: Whenever any unit dies, Phaisa units permanently gain 6% Attack Damage and Ability Power.
entries.trait.2.bp6: Whenever any unit dies, Phaisa units permanently gain 10% Attack Damage and Ability Power.
entries.trait.3.name: Hexagon
entries.trait.3.bp2: Hexagon units start combat with a 300 shield.
entries.trait.3.bp4: Hexagon units start combat with a 300 shield. When it breaks, it explodes and deals 120 magic damage to adjacent enemies.
entries.trait.9.name: Assassin
entries.trait.9.bp2: Assassins' abilities can critically strike. +20% Critical Strike Damage and +15% Critical Strike Chance.
entries.trait.9.bp4: Assassins' abilities can critically strike. +30% Critical Strike Damage and +25% Critical Strike Chance.
entries.trait.4.name: Omnilium
entries.trait.4.tagline: The First Matter. It has no synergy bonus of its own.
entries.trait.6.name: Selini
entries.trait.6.bp3: Once per combat, when falling below 50% HP, Selini units drop aggro for 2 s and heal 6% of their max HP.
entries.trait.7.name: Najmi
entries.trait.7.bp3: Whenever a Najmi unit casts its ability, adjacent allies gain 15 Mana.
entries.trait.8.name: Coregons
entries.trait.8.bp3: Coregons units heal for 7% of the damage they deal. Summons 2 untargetable Lost Souls with 14% of your tankiest ally's max HP.
entries.trait.8.bp6: Coregons units heal for 15% of the damage they deal. Summons 3 stronger Lost Souls with 40% of your tankiest ally's max HP. The Lost Soul Zone: enemies need +15 Mana to cast, allies gain +2 Mana per second, enemies lose 2% max HP per second while allies heal 2%, and enemies below 5% HP are executed.
entries.trait.8.bp8: Coregons units heal for 25% of the damage they deal. Summons 3 Lost Souls with 60% of your tankiest ally's max HP. The Underworld: the zone drains and heals 4% max HP per second and executes enemies below 10% HP.
entries.trait.5.name: Protector
entries.trait.5.bp2: All allies gain 10% Damage Amplification and 10% Armor and Magic Resist. Protectors gain the same bonus again.
